semantics.definition: The registry: it holds every definition in No Origins once, as a meron, and every change to one as a proposal a person approves.
semantics.responsibility: Keep each definition in one place, with its history, so that every system reads the same thing.

metadata.registered_because: Registered 17 Nov 2026 so that the 3D world has an arch for each of the five systems (page “The 3D World in Eidos”, decision 15).
